notes.title: Winter 2021 update
notes.notes:
I know you all were waiting for that for long time! Finally, the game obtained its own set of animated wallpapers! As I know, many players bought the game not only for playing but also for getting an awesome wallpaper. Until that moment, you could only get a static one. From now, you will also receive a cool, animated, high quality background image!
Here is  a preview of some of these wallpapers/backgrounds:
[previewyoutube=zvoF2qdI61c;full][/previewyoutube]
And a gif animation (slightly accelerated due to gif compression):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26015213/be7ff8789dcc97b9333dabdcee57ad4343445fca.gif[/img]

All the animated ones plus last three are the static ones.
Also don't miss the awesome ambient soundtrack from the game!
Enjoy and don't forget about my another release - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/559030]Siege Saga[/url]!


Optika: https://store.steampowered.com/app/504400/
Siege Saga: https://store.steampowered.com/app/559030
Optika Soundtrack: https://store.steampowered.com/app/516910

Also, the game tutorial was updated and become even more intuitive; some minor bugs were fixed including ultra wide screen resolution glitches.

Some translations were updated.

notes.title: New language support - Dutch and Polish for Optika!
notes.notes:
Additional languages are here! 
Hey there, we have a new languages available - Polish and Dutch!
So now the game supports 7 languages.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26015213/c549dd253b479e90587fad21e17d26e61b393fe4.gif[/img]

The new languages have just gone live, so if the option is not showing up for you right now, it's possible the bits are still making their way through the system to where your computer is. Please be patience :)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26015213/75bedba32b6202c759a4754b1600f707122b6f6a.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26015213/50f809f1ede81dc89d997aeb09d83dc251f87bbc.png[/img]

notes.title: Levels improvements and minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey, we've just made a few levels much harder to solve!

50th level achievement is now up and working, just finish any level (again?) and hit the Next level button to get the achievement. There also was a few reports that the game wasn't loading, that is fixed as well.

These three levels were completely changed:
- THE FORCE IS WITH YOU - level 10
- THE FORCE IS WITH YOU - level 4
- THROUGH THE LOOKING GLASS - level 4 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26015213/ae1d22a4ab7af4db574994fdf13add69b54fe6b5.jpg[/img]

Best regards,
Vadim
